Four card changes are explicitly self-authored execution supplements; observation-only award status and source associations are unchanged.
The optional entry pin is a new complete opt-in pair. Old entries omitting both fields remain compatible; this is not retroactive assignment of old revisions.

No new model-output comparison, figure/page rendering or actual Skill-consumption test was performed; behavioral and aesthetic benefit remain unverified.
Historical gallery and audit bytes were preserved, not rerun or reinterpreted as current behavioral acceptance.
Synthetic arithmetic probes check the guidance meaning only; they do not prove future model compliance.
The root-run full241 software report is separate evidence, not this reviewer's own execution.
Public documentation audit links must exist before commit; their planned names were read, but new evidence files are outside the source-review hash set.
